title: On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. translated_title: 论时间序列世界模型中预测准确率与机制一致性的分歧
translated_abstract: 时间序列世界模型（TSWM）根据受控系统的观测历史、规划动作和外生输入来预测其状态。当前方法将动作作为协变量来构建预测器，并在已执行计划下的预测误差上进行训练与评估。然而，世界模型的用途是比较未执行的计划，而模型对计划变化的响应却从未得到检验。我们提出两个问题：哪些设计选择真正重要？准确的预测器是否会像真实系统那样对变化的计划做出响应？我们通过一个形式化框架和基准测试来回答这两个问题。该形式化框架将状态、动作和外生输入分离开来，区分了连续动作、模式动作和事件动作，并引入了“机制一致性”这一指标——它建立在方向已知的动作-状态关系声明之上（例如升压药会升高血压），用于检验改变某个动作是否会使预测朝声明的方向移动。该基准整合了八个包含真实动作的公开数据集（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文为时间序列世界模型提出了形式化框架与基准，引入“机制一致性”指标来检验模型对动作变化的响应方向是否符合真实系统的因果规律，并揭示了预测准确率与机制一致性之间的分歧。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a formalization and benchmark for time series world models, introducing "mechanism consistency" to test whether forecasts respond to changed actions in declared causal directions, revealing a divergence between predictive accuracy and mechanism consistency.
